recessed.$description: Input fields, slider tracks, recessed channels

matte.$description: Disabled button fills, subtle divider backgrounds

tinted.$description: Parchment band (the recessed surface in dark: dark tinted is not a signature surface): page bands, Tabs track, grouped regions. Pair with data-surface="tinted"

velvet.$description: Plum velvet band: signature bands with ivory text. Pair with data-surface="velvet"

primary.$description: Headings, body text, primary labels (16.28:1 on surface — WCAG AAA)

secondary.$description: Descriptions, helper text, secondary labels (5.27:1 on surface — WCAG AA)

tertiary.$description: Placeholders, disabled text, timestamps (4.53:1 on surface — WCAG AA minimum)

on-accent.$description: Text on accent-filled backgrounds (primary buttons, badges)

default.$description: Default borders for cards, inputs, dividers (3.06:1 on surface — WCAG AA UI)

strong.$description: Emphasized borders, active input outlines (3.49:1 on surface — WCAG AA UI)

default.$description: Primary buttons, focus rings, active/selected states only

muted.$description: Subtle accent backgrounds (selected rows, active tabs)

plum.$description: Plum: the voice. Highlighted, never selected; never the only signal

default.$description: Highlighted (not selected) states, hover tints of secondary and ghost controls, caret, selection

verdigris.$description: Verdigris: live. Never the only signal

default.$description: Live service state: live dot, now-line, real-time counts

focus.$description: Focus ring, separate from the gold fill so a band can deepen it (ADR-035)

ring.$description: Focus ring colour (defaults to the accent)

gap.$description: Gap drawn between a control and its focus ring (defaults to the surface)

default.$description: Error text, destructive button fills, invalid borders

muted.$description: Error alert backgrounds, error badge tints

default.$description: Warning text, caution banners, pending states

muted.$description: Warning alert backgrounds, warning badge tints
Success alert backgrounds, success badge tints

neon.$description: NeonSign tube tones — lit tube text and strokes only, never fills

red.$description: Red neon tube (AA on the recessed housing and its glow wash)
